<section class="about scatter" aria-label="About">
  <p class="label sc-label" data-reveal>About</p>
  <p class="ab-lead sc-lead" data-reveal>I study how <strong>emotion regulation</strong> unfolds from moment to moment, how the family system shapes it, and when regulation under stress promotes health.</p>
  <figure class="sc-ph sc-tower" data-reveal data-speed="-0.06"><img src="images/home/photo-2535.jpg" alt="" loading="lazy"></figure>
  <figure class="sc-ph sc-portrait" data-reveal data-speed="0.04"><img src="images/profile.jpg" alt="Yingying Tang"></figure>
  <div class="sc-card sc-c1" data-reveal data-speed="-0.02"><p>My work spans <strong>laboratory measures of physiological regulation and observed behavior</strong>, <strong>multi-informant surveys</strong>, and <strong>daily diary and other intensive longitudinal designs</strong>.</p></div>
  <div class="sc-tags" data-reveal data-speed="0.07" aria-label="Software"><span>R</span><span>Mplus</span><span>SPSS</span><span>Stata</span><span>MATLAB</span></div>
  <figure class="sc-ph sc-mtn" data-reveal data-speed="0.09"><img src="images/home/photo-2375.jpg" alt="" loading="lazy"></figure>
  <div class="sc-card sc-c2" data-reveal data-speed="0.03"><p>I work with <a href="https://liberalarts.utexas.edu/hdfs/">Dr. Aprile Benner</a> at UT Austin. Before this I earned an M.A. in Developmental Psychology and a B.S. in Psychology at Beijing Normal University.</p></div>
  <figure class="sc-ph sc-snow" data-reveal data-speed="-0.05"><img src="images/home/photo-5707.jpg" alt="" loading="lazy"></figure>
  <div class="sc-card sc-c3" data-reveal data-speed="-0.03"><p>I also <strong>teach research methods</strong>, both as instructor of record and as a teaching assistant across undergraduate research methods classes and graduate statistics classes, and I run an <a href="teaching.html">annual R workshop</a> for graduate students in my department.</p></div>
  <p class="links sc-links" data-reveal data-speed="0.02"><a href="mailto:yingyingtang@utexas.edu">Email</a><a href="https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=FKmNCvwAAAAJ">Google Scholar</a><a href="https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Yingying-Tang-3">ResearchGate</a></p>
</section>
